name: Inside open short
note: Saurabh's inside-open rule (built 28 Nov 2026), short side: price above 2,000, the first five minutes (09:15-09:20) stayed inside yesterday's range (day high below PDH, day low above PDL), and at 09:20 the price is below VWAP (the 1-minute session VWAP, as the chart draws it). The last rule only asks that the first five minutes exist (four bars before the current one). One run a day, at 09:20, written on the state at that minute so the live engine and the replay read the same thing. Short, stop = the high of the first five minutes, first target = yesterday's low. Every fire of the two Inside open scans goes out as one quiet Telegram summary; the three strongest on each side (furthest from VWAP) are starred and only they get follow-ups. "desk": "rows" = a trade row (odds, size, outcome) for every fire, no desk verdict. Study on 70 stored sessions (18 Aug-27 Nov 2026, exit 15:15, 0.10 % costs): about 30 fires a morning for the two sides together, 36 % reached the target first, 51 % were stopped first, +0.02 % a trade before costs and -0.08 % after; no month positive. Starred and with the market: about 2 a day, break-even after costs. On paper test, not a proven edge.
